fixed_policy.land_choice: first in actual shuffled hand order among supported basic or 19 named nonbasic cards; one land per turn
fixed_policy.shock_choice: pay 2 life to enter untapped when pilot life greater than 2, otherwise enter tapped; never claim strategic optimality
fixed_policy.mana_sources: Only physically controlled untapped basic or 19 registered nonbasic lands; do not treat Arcane Signet already on battlefield as a mana source
fixed_policy.source_payment: Choose a deterministic legal set of real untapped land source IDs; assign exact U/B/R/C colors satisfying pips/generic and prefer no activation life payment
fixed_policy.mana_confluence: Tap and pay 1 life as activation cost; never count controller life payments toward opponent-life-lost threshold
fixed_policy.turn_policy: same original shuffled opening 7 plus one physical library draw each turn for four turns; no extra draw effects
fixed_policy.access_target: Arcane Signet only; all other spells remain unmodeled in sampled trials
fixed_policy.unrecognized_land: not playable as a modeled mana source; record unsupported seen-in-hand; never invent its ETB or mana
fixed_policy.entry_conditions: typed duals and shocklands contribute subtype Island, Swamp or Mountain for typed-check lands; basic land subtypes honored
fixed_policy.reproducibility: exact original Cycle102 seed/deck order; compare every opening hand and each of four draws to frozen previous Cycle102 receipts

oracle_gate: For every registered land, verify name, type land, source-backed mana symbols, and applicable enter tapped/shock/typed/multiplayer conditions against pinned October 2026 bulk. Fail if archived Oracle text differs materially.
tests: Shockland pay-two/decline choice preserves pilot life and tapped state
Printed subtype checking considers typed duals as well as basics
Fastland land-count threshold: 2 other lands versus 3
Multiplayer bond-land is untapped only with at least two opponents
Crumbling Necropolis and Xander's Lounge enter tapped
Mana Confluence costs one controller life for actual activated mana
Colored mana assignment uses real legal source choices and pays card cost
Block duplicate land plays, unsupported lands and source tap while tapped without mutation
Original 744 hand/draw sequences and 100-card IDs match exactly
No approved deck change, M6 status change, game win-rate or Phase B certificate
limitations: This remains four scripted controller turns, no mulligans, no opponents' turns, opponent choices or full priority
Only 19 explicitly registered nonbasic mana-land names are supported; all other lands are out of model
No City of Brass or Ancient Tomb damage-trigger timing, fetches, MDFC, cycling, scry, tutor, or most utility abilities
No full Commander gameplay, final legality audit, deck strength comparison or independent Pass C/I/J
More source-backed Arcane Signet casts measures model coverage; cannot be interpreted as commander power
